searchText: I think we are running a non-release version of besu on calaveras, will fix. Thx for the heads up <@!543900561460822016> here's the PR: https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-apis/pull/2 I'll be able to get this done by next meeting <@543900561460822016> can you please add me with admin access to the apis repo? The freedom will make it easier to work on the rpc stuff <@!104006934562107392> what sort of things do you need access to? I want to be and to make branches and to add / remove people like <@181920051333431296> its fine if you also want to add him and me with write access though we just updated the nodes to the latest version. I just tested a GetBlockByNumber and it's now ok I'd prefer branches be managed externally under your own forks. If you need to collaborate on a certain branch, you can add one another as contributors on your fork. I do the same - this keeps the branch name space on the upstream clean and forces us to follow the same process that external contributors how do you keep your fork updated with master? I rebase changes in, so usually `git fetch upstream && git rebase upstream/master` and repair any conflicts huh, okay. the biggest issue is that it's so much easier to keep branches up to date, but if that's easy enough then I guess it doesn't matter you'll have to track the ethereum repo as `upstream` though, so `git remote add upstream git@github.com:ethereum/eth1.0-apis.git` to start tracking replace ssh address with https if you don't use ssh keys `https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-apis.git` github is so annoying 🤦‍♀️ but okay, thank you for the help
